import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
def feats(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    Z={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==0}
    D2=[(a,b) for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1)]
    def nbc(p,r): return {q for a,b in D2 if abs(a)<=r and abs(b)<=r for p=(a,b) for q in [p]} if False else [(p[0]+a,p[1]+b) for a,b in D2 if abs(a)<=r and abs(b)<=r for p=(0,0) for q in [p]]
    # redo cleanly
    cnt=defaultdict(list)
    D2n=[(a,b) for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1) if (a,b)!=(0,0)]
    for i,j in Z:
        c2=sum(1 for a,b in D2n if abs(a)<=1 and abs(b)<=1 and 0<=i+a<H and 0<=j+b<W and I[i+a][j+b]==2)
        d2=min((abs(i-a)+abs(j-b)) for a,b in D2n if 0<=i+a<H and 0<=j+b<W and I[i+a][j+b]==2) if False else -1
        D2k=[(a,b) for a,b in D2n if abs(a)<=1 and abs(b)<=1]
        d2=min([abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in D2k if 0<=i+a<H and 0<=j+b<W and I[i+a][j+b]==2], default=99)
        D3k=[(a,b) for a,b in D2n if abs(a)<=1 and abs(b)<=1]
        d3=min([abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in D3k if 0<=i+a<H and 0<=j+b<W and I[i+a][j+b]==3], default=99)
        cnt[(i,j)].append((c2,d2,d3,O[i][j]))
    return cnt
cnt=feats(G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output'])
for k,v in cnt.items(): print(k,v[:8])
